propositions: A standing per-criterion effectiveness recorder is needed that accumulates firing history from sidecar re-review data alone, without outcome-corpus git-walks, to enable cheap and incremental dogfood monitoring of advisory criteria at zero marginal LLM cost.

The recorder must auto-include any criterion id it observes in sidecars and compute detection_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units later remediated to PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (fraction later de-escalated/dropped and never remediated) over a configurable trailing window of reviewed tickets.
The append-only firing ledger must be idempotent (dedup key = ticket+review_ts+round_uuid+norm_id) and prune-immune, capturing firings before the sidecar's 50-round retention prune drops them.
The --report output must auto-include every criterion id present in the ledger and emit null (not fabricated 0.0) for any proxy with a zero denominator.

Documentation must specify the standing cadence (incremental --record then --report), the advisory-to-blocking promotion gate protocol for R1/R3/R4 criteria, and the distinction from R7's outcome-corpus metric.
